Find your next car, anywhere in Pakistan.

Car Empire is Pakistan's car marketplace — buy and sell cars in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad and across the country, in PKR. Every listing is posted by a registered seller and reviewed by the owner before it goes public, and our blog & community forums are free for everyone to read.

How Car Empire works

1

Register & post

Create your free account and post your car with photos, price and city. Your ad is saved to your own dashboard.

2

Owner approval

Every new ad starts as Pending. The site owner reviews it in the owner panel and approves, rejects or deletes it.

3

Offers & inspection

Approved ads are public across Pakistan. Buyers call the seller straight from the ad, WhatsApp them, chat with them on Car Empire, send offers and book inspections — sellers manage everything from their dashboard.

Selling a car?

Post it in two minutes. It goes live as soon as the owner approves it.

Sell your car

Your ad goes to the owner for approval before it appears publicly.

First-time owner setup — in Supabase

No owner account exists yet, and it can only be created in Supabase — never on this website. First run this one-time SQL in Supabase → SQL Editor: it first adds the missing country and password columns to the users table, then adds the role column, protects every password, and adds a database rule that allows only ONE owner row, ever.


        
        
Then create the owner: Supabase → Table Editor → users → Insert row — name, email, password, country, and set role to owner. Come back here and log in with that email and password. Forgot the password later? Delete the owner row in Supabase and insert a new one.

Privacy Policy — Car Empire

    

      
Last updated: November 2026. This page explains, in plain words, what information Car Empire collects when you use the marketplace and what we do with it.

      
What we collect. When you create an account we store your name, your public username, your profile picture, your email and your city. When you post a car we store the ad details, the photos and video you upload, and the mobile number you give for buyers to contact you. When you browse, we count ad views and clicks so sellers can see them in their own dashboard — these counts are never shown publicly.

      
How we use it. Your information is used only to run the marketplace: showing your ads, letting buyers contact you, reviewing listings before they go public, and keeping accounts secure. Your mobile number is shown on your own ads through the Show Number button, because that is how buyers reach you.

      
What we never do. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share your email address with advertisers. Forum posts and blog comments are public by design — please do not post private information in them.

      
Your choices. You can edit your profile, change your profile picture, or delete your own ads at any time from your dashboard. To ask for your account data to be removed, email us at techmateen9@gmail.com.

      
Contact. Questions about this policy: techmateen9@gmail.com · Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan.
